description: Find registered lookalike domains of a brand's website: the brand's name on other endings, with common words such as login or pay, as .shop names of the kind copied stores use (also for the shorter name a brand goes by when its domain ends in a word such as supply or store), and a few misspellings. Checks which of them resolve in DNS and what their front page shows (a page using the brand's name, another live site, or nothing); a misspelling counts only when its page uses the brand's name, and a name that lands on the brand's own site is left out. Returns how many were found and at most five of them. Read-only. Same check as https://openbait.com/tools/typosquat-check.

domain.description: the brand's website, e.g. example.com or https://www.example.com

name: check_lookalike_domains

domain.description: the registrable domain that was checked

lookalikes.description: at most five registered lookalikes, names using the brand's name first

blocked.description: live_other only: the site answered with a bot check, so its page was not read

site.description: what the front page shows: brand_page (uses the brand's name), live_other (another live site), no_site (nothing there) or unread (registered, page not read in time)

checked.description: how many names were looked up in DNS

found.description: how many registered lookalikes were found

more.description: how many of found are not listed in lookalikes

title: Check lookalike domains
